Sobriety date calculator

How your sober time is calculated

The day count is the number of calendar days between your start date and today. Your start date is day zero. The breakdown counts years, months, and days, accounting for different month lengths. Dates use your device’s local time zone; daylight-saving changes do not change the day count.

Your next milestone may be a set number of days or a calendar anniversary. A month is not always 30 days. You can enter any personal start date; the calculator does not choose a sobriety date for you.

What is Committed?

Committed tracks the time since a date, your milestones, and more than one commitment. You can use it for sobriety, nicotine, social media, or another personal commitment.

There is no account, no social feed, no ads, and no analytics. Tracking is free with no time limit. Lifetime Unlock adds premium features with a one-time purchase.

Learn more about the iPhone app

Apple Watch

The Apple Watch app shows your commitments and milestones. Complications can keep your count on your watch face throughout the day.

See how Committed works on Apple Watch

Privacy

Your commitments, dates, milestones, and settings are stored on your device. If you enable backup, Committed uses your private iCloud account.

Committed does not use analytics, advertising identifiers, or developer servers. The developer cannot view or retrieve your commitments.

Common questions

Do I need an account?
No.

Is it a subscription?
No. Lifetime Unlock is an optional one-time purchase.

Does it work on Apple Watch?
Yes. The Apple Watch app and complications are included with Lifetime Unlock.

What can I track?
Sobriety, nicotine, social media, or another personal commitment.
